cases.title: An equilateral triangle around a circle has the circle inside it
lines: משולש ABC חוסם את מעגל O
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The circle is inside the triangle and touches all three sides; every row green.
cases.before: At 15–16 of 24 configurations the circle was drawn outside the triangle, shown green.

cases.title: A right angle around a circle: every other view keeps the circle inside
lines: משולש ABC חוסם את מעגל O
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Then press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» 5 times. Every view is green with the circle inside the triangle, and the triangle's shape changes.
cases.before: 7 of 9 presses showed the circle outside the triangle.

cases.title: A quadrilateral around a circle with AB = AD
lines: מרובע ABCD חוסם את מעגל O
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». A kite around the circle; the circle is inside and touches all four sides. Allow about 4 s.

cases.title: An impossible side length around a circle is never green
lines: משולש ABC חוסם את מעגל O
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Wait about 10 s. The «AB = 4» row is NOT green: it shows ✗ (problem), with the message «לא נמצאה תצורה שמקיימת את כל הדרישות יחד — הציור המוצג עשוי להיות מנוון (למשל נקודות שמתלכדות). בדקו את הנתון האחרון שהוזן.». The circle stays inside the triangle. The ruling said amber; see the Heads-up.
cases.before: Green, with O drawn as an excircle.
cases.verifiedByProbe: timed probe on :5173: «AB = 4» settled in 10.2 s; row ✗; the refusal text above

cases.title: The exam figure's equal-arcs line still builds, slowly
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The last line takes about 27 s (the slowdown you accepted until #2601). Then: an isosceles right triangle with the right angle at B, both circles, the tangent at B, every row ✓.
cases.before: The same result in about 10 s.
cases.verifiedByProbe: timed probe on :5173: «קשת AB = קשת BC» settled in 27.3 s; all 5 rows ✓; no refusal

cases.title: The prism shows both values of k
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The data panel reads «k = -1 או k = 2».

cases.title: Both prisms are reachable
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» several times. The prism switches between two clearly different drawings (k = −1 and k = 2), and every step stays green. On about 1 press in 4 the panel may read «k = ?»: that sample is honestly incomplete.
cases.before: Almost always the k = 2 prism only.

cases.title: Two vectors leave two values of k
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The panel reads «k = 1 או k = 2».

cases.title: A third vector fixes k (unchanged)
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The panel reads «k = 2».

cases.title: A typed point on a plane with a letter finds the letter
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The last line is accepted, A lies on π, and the data panel reads «m = -2».
cases.before: Refused: A is not on the plane.

cases.title: A typed point on a line with a letter
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Accepted; the panel reads «m = 2».
cases.before: Refused: A is not on the line.

cases.title: Two values of the letter, cycled
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The panel reads «m = ±2»; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» swaps the drawn line between the two.

cases.title: REFUSAL: no value of the letter works
cases.expectRefusal: אין אף ערך ממשי של m
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The last line is refused with «אין אף ערך ממשי של m שבו «A על המישור π» מתקיים…» (read the whole sentence), and the figure is unchanged.
cases.before: Refused: A is not on the plane.

cases.title: A point on the plane for every m leaves m open
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Accepted; the panel reads «m = ?»; the plane turns on «הציגו תצורה אחרת».

cases.title: REFUSAL: a point off the line once m is fixed (2024 winter Q2)
lines: ℓ אינו מקביל ל-π לכל m
cases.expectRefusal: הנתונים האלה סותרים זה את זה
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The last line is refused, naming «C(1,1,1) על הישר ℓ» together with «הישר ℓ ניצב למישור π» and ending «הנתונים האלה סותרים זה את זה» (read the whole sentence). This wording is new: see the Heads-up.
cases.before: Refused: C is not on the line.

cases.title: A cube vertex on a plane with a letter (unchanged)
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Builds as before.

cases.title: Place a point on a cube edge by its distance
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Builds; E sits at the middle of AB; every row green.
cases.before: The last line was refused «בדקו את החישוב».

cases.title: Same, with the distance before the size
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Builds; E at the middle of AB.

cases.title: An angle at a point on an edge, no size stated
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Builds; ∠ADE is marked 30°.

cases.title: A distance between points on two edges
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Builds.

cases.title: REFUSAL: a distance longer than the edge
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The last line is refused as a contradiction naming «AE = 3» and «AB = 2» (read the whole sentence).

cases.title: REFUSAL: a diagonal that does not fit the size
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Only the last line is refused «בדקו את החישוב».

cases.title: A box with a point on an edge (unchanged)
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Builds.

cases.title: «w = u + v» over two declared vectors draws the head-to-tail triangle
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Three coloured floating arrows u, v, w (three hues). A faded dashed copy of v starts at u's head, and w runs from u's tail to the copy's head — a closed triangle. The separate v still floats in the tray. On «הציגו תצורה אחרת» the triangle changes shape and stays closed.
cases.before: The third line was refused: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לחשב ביטוי שבו מופיע הווקטור החופשי u, ולכן «w = u + v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»

cases.title: Subtraction and a multiple follow the same rule: «w = 2u - v»
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Two faded dashed copies chained head to tail from w's tail: one along u, twice as long (2u), then one pointing opposite to v (−v); w closes the triangle from the start of the 2u copy to the end of the −v copy.
cases.before: The third line was refused («… «w = 2u - v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: With stated components the sum is a value: the panel and the ask read it
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The triangle drawn. Data panel: stated rows «u = (1, 2, 3)», «v = (1, 1, 1)», «w = u + v»; the vectors section shows w = (2, 3, 4) with |w|. Asking «u + v» answers (2, 3, 4); asking «2u - 3v» answers (-1, 1, 3).
cases.before: «w = u + v» was refused; asking «u + v» was not understood.

cases.title: An equation among existing vectors solves a letter: k = 2
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». All four lines accepted. The panel's parameters row reads «k = 2», and asking «k» answers 2.
cases.before: The fourth line was refused («… «w = u + v» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: A component written with a letter, then the letter valued
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». After the first line: one floating arrow u, the panel reads «u = (k-1, 2, k)» and «k = ?». After «k = 3»: the panel reads «u = (2, 2, 3)» and «k = 3».
cases.before: The first line was refused («הכלי עדיין לא יודע לחשב ביטוי שבו מופיע הווקטור החופשי u, ולכן «u = (k-1, 2, k)» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: Givens that cannot all hold are refused, naming the lines
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The fourth line is refused with the full sentence: «הנתונים סותרים זה את זה — אין גוף שמקיים את «w = u + v» יחד עם «u = (1,1,1)», «v = (1,1,1)», «w = (3,2,3)»». The first three stay.
cases.before: Refused with the interim «… זו מגבלה של הכלי.» message.

cases.title: A free vector from a cube's named vector: «p = 2u» is twice the edge
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The cube with the teal arrow u = AB. p (its own hue) floats in the tray, twice as long as AB and parallel to it. Panel: «p = 2u».
cases.before: The fourth line was refused («… «p = 2u» לא נוסף — זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: A stated free vector equated to an edge pins the edge
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The cube is turned and sized so that AB = (1, 2, 3); asking «AB» answers (1, 2, 3).
cases.before: «AB = p» was refused («… זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).

cases.title: REFUSAL — a statement the tool cannot yet solve together with the figure
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The last line is refused with the full sentence: «הכלי עדיין לא יודע לפתור את «AD = p» עם הווקטור החופשי p, ולכן השורה לא נוספה — זו מגבלה של הכלי.» The first three lines stay (p follows AB).
cases.before: «AB = p» was already refused («… זו מגבלה של הכלי.»).
